messages:
olivia: opened a PR to update the Nebula3b model card — sequence limits and perf numbers need polishing. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
sam: nice, link looks good. can you call out the quantized variant behavior? customers keep asking what falls back to CPU
miguel: yep. need to include a short note on CPU fallback perf delta and a small snippet showing how to request the quantized variant.
ben: also a minor SDK snippet nit: we use `context_tokens` in examples now, not `max_tokens`. can we standardize?
tara: i'll run a quick script to verify the card example build locally. heads-up: cross-link to runtime compat matrix is broken in the PR (404)
docs-bot: link-checker: failed links found in changed files: /docs/runtime/compat -> 404
olivia: thanks — updated the link to /docs/runtime/compatibility and left a redirect in the site config. fixed the example to use `context_tokens` as well.
nate: i ran microbench on p3.2xlarge for both fp16 and our quantized path. raw numbers: fp16 baseline ~2200 tok/s, quantized ~1800 tok/s. CPU fallback ~420 tok/s. i'll paste the run output below.
nate: ```
# perf run snippet
model=nebula3b
batch=1
seq=2048
fp16: 2200 tok/s
int8-quant: 1800 tok/s
cpu-fallback: 420 tok/s
```
miguel: thanks — can we express those as relative deltas in the card? e.g., ~-18% quant vs fp16, and ~-81% cpu vs fp16. customers understand percentages better.
ben: added a short try/except example for the SDK so users can gracefully fallback: ```python
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="nebula3b:quant", input="...")
except InferenceUnavailableError:
    resp = client.generate(model="nebula3b", input="...", prefer_cpu=True)
```
tara: LGTM. i validated the docs build locally; the sample code renders and the link now resolves. one tiny thing: the bench table needs a caption and units (tok/s).
olivia: done — i added a small table, the percentages, and a short note under "compatibility" explaining quantized behavioral differences (cache size, cold-start). left a TODO for longer-run memory profiles.
sam: can we also add a short paragraph in the migration guide section advising teams to pin the variant for reproducible perf? eg: `model: nebula3b@v2026-03-01`
olivia: added that pinning example and a checklist item for release notes. merging after one more :eyes: from infra.
miguel: quick nit: change wording "cold-start" -> "first-token latency" in the perf paragraph — more precise.
olivia: updated wording. thanks.
docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/nebula3b-card-789. visual diff looks fine.
ben: one more ask — can we add an example of embedding compatibility note (nebula3b embeddings are not identical to nebula3b-chat embeddings)? short sentence in the "supported features" section should do it.
olivia: added that line and a link to the embedding policy doc. merging now. :shipit:
